{{Top|leg}}
'''Glorim''' was a city on the planet [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] around [[2974 BBY]]. It was located on the southeastern coast of the continent of [[Keshtah Minor]]. As with other parts of the planet, it was ruled by the [[Lost Tribe of Sith]], the descendants of [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] who had become stranded on Kesh during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. As with other urban settlements, Glorim had a local constabulary that was tasked with enforcing law and order. The Sith outcast [[Parlan Spinner]] was known to have visited the settlement prior to his capture and banishment from Keshtah.
